title: 26 November 1961: Live: Hambleton Hall, Liverpool
content:
This was The Beatles’ 14th performance at Hambleton Hall in Huyton, Liverpool.

It was booked by Wally Hill and Vic Anton, the promoters at the hall at the east of Liverpool. Hambleton Hall was a shabby municipal building which later became a probation office, situated on St David’s Road in Page Moss, Huyton.

The Beatles played at Hambleton Hall on 16 occasions. The other dates were 25 January; 1, 8, 15 and 22 February; 8 and 20 March; 20 August; 3 and 17 September; 15 and 29 October; 12 November; 10 December 1961; and 13 January 1962.

Page last updated: 24 January 2024
